captions: This freehold | in [BROMPTON] | brings in [£90,320] a year | from [10 UNITS] | as *one freehold asset,* | and it's available for sale | at offers in the region of | [£1,000,000.] It's [10 AND 12 HIGH STREET,] | two *adjoining buildings* | with a *self-contained flat* | to the rear. I'll take you through | the *location,* | the *building* | and the [NUMBERS.] Brompton sits | between *Chatham* | and *Gillingham* | in [MEDWAY, KENT.] Chatham Historic Dockyard | is [HALF A MILE] away, | Brompton Barracks | is *closer still,* | and the University of Greenwich | Medway campus | is about [A MILE] away. Gillingham station | is also around a mile away, | with trains into *St Pancras* | in about [44 MINUTES.] On the ground floor | there are [TWO SHOPS,] | a hair studio at number 10 | and a nail parlour business | at number 12, | each on a [10-YEAR LEASE] | at [£10,000] a year. Above the shops | there are [TWO HMOS,] | three rooms over number 10 | and four rooms over number 12, | averaging [£680] a month per room, | *bills included.* And to the rear, | with its own access | on *Westcourt Street,* | there's a self-contained flat | let at [£13,200] a year. In total, | it's [3,829 SQ FT] | across all *five units.* Now the [NUMBERS.] The passing rent | is [£90,320] a year, | which is a [9% GROSS YIELD] | at the asking price. The landlord pays the bills | on the *HMO rooms,* | which come to [£995] a month. Take those off | and the income is [£78,380,] | or [7.8% NET YIELD.] Residential makes up | [78%] of the income | and the shops make up [22%.] Because it's a *mixed-use* building, | stamp duty is charged | at *non-residential rates.* At the asking price, | that's [£39,500.] With a [30% DEPOSIT] | and interest-only finance | at [6%,] | the income after interest | is [£36,380] a year, | which is a [10.7% RETURN] | on the cash you put in. Those figures are *illustrative* | and set out in the | *investment summary.* The shop leases | have *tenant breaks* | in [JANUARY 2027] | and [JULY 2028.] The full lease events | are set out | in the investment summary. The building is sold | with the *tenants in place,* | and viewings are | strictly by [APPOINTMENT.] It's available now | before the *full launch* | across all major property platforms. If you'd like | the investment summary | or a viewing, | register at calibreacquire.co.uk/register. I look at every registration | [PERSONALLY,] | and I'll be in touch | if it's a good fit.
